title: Aso-Ebi Infiltration
summary: Enter honestly on a labelled invitation, help catering, inspect a permitted ledger excerpt and hear Nneka privately with a saved permission boundary.

stages.title: Invited, with a job to do
stages.text:
Ngozi and KC are invited as catering guests to the Chief's mother's ninetieth birthday. The card permits the marked family/service area, not private rooms.
KC: Infiltration sounds more dramatic on my channel.
Ngozi: So does washing plates. We are still doing it.

Use the invitation honestly. Ask before inspecting records or interviewing anyone.
stages.summary: Read the limited invitation and enter honestly as invited catering guests.

records.title: Birthday invitation · catering guests
lines: Private rooms and records: ask separately

choices.label: Use the invitation within its permitted areas
Invent a family identity to enter private rooms
choices.hint: The invitation already gives access to the marked area. Private rooms need separate permission.

stages.title: A colour with a shape beside it
stages.text:
The usher checks the printed marker, not anyone's complexion, accent or clothes.
Usher: The triangle is doing most of the security work today.

Match the printed SAGE + TRIANGLE. Words and shape carry the same information as colour.
stages.summary: Match the labelled SAGE + TRIANGLE marker without a colour-only cue.

choices.label: SAGE + TRIANGLE · matches the invitation
GOLD + CIRCLE · another guest marker
choices.hint: Your invitation says SAGE + TRIANGLE. Use the written labels.

choices.label: SAGE + SQUARE · another shape
choices.hint: The printed shape is TRIANGLE. The same colour alone does not match.

stages.title: The family table has a questionnaire
stages.text:
Relative: Which side are you from?
Ngozi: The side that brought the food.
KC: Is that a branch?
Ngozi: It has the strongest attendance.

The invitation names catering guests. Give the same truthful answer.
stages.summary: Answer the family-table question truthfully using the invitation.

choices.label: We are invited catering guests
Say we are cousins of a cousin
choices.hint: Use the actual invitation. Guests do not need an invented family relationship.

stages.title: Ninety. In large print.
stages.text:
Relative: And whose birthday is it?
Ngozi: Mother's ninetieth.
Relative: Good. Last year a banner congratulated the chairman on retirement. He was visiting.

Use the event printed on the invitation.
stages.summary: Identify Mother's 90th birthday from the invitation.

choices.label: Mother's 90th birthday
The Chief's campaign launch
choices.hint: This invitation is for Mother's 90th birthday. The fictional council contest comes later.

stages.title: An invitation is not a queue ticket
stages.text:
A caterer asks for help matching a meal ticket.
Ngozi: KC, your audience can survive a tray.
KC: I was going to call it a live unboxing.

Ticket 22 requests tray B, the covered rice dish. Check number and letter.
stages.summary: Match the written meal ticket to the covered tray.

choices.label: Ticket 22 to tray B · covered rice
Ticket 22 to tray C · another order
choices.hint: Ticket 22 specifies tray B. Match the written number and letter first.

stages.title: The shortest route has people in it
stages.text:
Ngozi waits for a clear marked service aisle. KC keeps equipment off the chairs.
Caterer: You may be our most useful guests.
Ngozi: Put that in writing before the next family question.
stages.summary: Wait for the service aisle to clear and deliver the agreed tray without pushing guests.

choices.label: Wait for a clear aisle, then deliver tray B
Push between guests to save time
choices.hint: The tray can wait. Use the clear service aisle.

stages.title: Mother edits the title
stages.text:
Chief: Distinguished Honourable Grand—
Mother: Your name is Femi. Bring me a chair.

The event usher confirms Ngozi and KC entered today as catering guests. That confirms their visit, not the wedding bag's journey.
stages.summary: Retain the usher's limited confirmation of this invited visit.

choices.label: Record today's invited visit with its limits
Call the usher a witness to the wedding bag
choices.hint: The usher confirms today's visit, not the bag's wedding journey.

stages.title: Ask before opening the ledger
stages.text:
The service custodian permits a desk inspection of the wedding reference index. The book stays there. Unrelated guest details must not be copied.
Ngozi: We need one reference, not everybody's lunch history.
stages.summary: Accept a supervised limited index inspection; leave the ledger with its custodian.

choices.label: Accept the limited desk inspection
Take the ledger away while the custodian is busy
choices.hint: Permission is for a desk inspection. The ledger remains with its custodian.

stages.title: Three sources, three different jobs
stages.text:
Compare CAT-18, SR-18 and the full private wedding source. The index links CAT-18 to a blue folder marked Receipts and promises. It does not establish ownership or every person's actions.

Restore any missing previously earned source through the journal before continuing.
stages.summary: Compare the permitted index with the invoice, service time and original without overstating its claim.

records.title: Permitted wedding reference excerpt
lines: Folder: Receipts and promises · blue cover
Scope: reference links, not ownership or a complete timeline

choices.label: Compare all three earned sources with the permitted index
Say the index alone proves the complete story
choices.hint: An index locates references. Compare the invoice, time record and original; it does not settle the full sequence.

stages.title: A folder with a better memory
stages.text:
The custodian recognises the blue folder label from the wedding inventory. The recorded bag has not been opened here. Inspect its contents later with the recorded property custodian.
KC: A diary?
Ngozi: First a lead. Then a witnessed inspection.
stages.summary: Save the folder lead for a later witnessed inspection; the diary is not yet recovered.

choices.label: Keep the lead for the property-custodian comparison
Claim we already recovered and verified the diary
choices.hint: This is a folder reference. The diary still needs inspection with the recorded property custodian.

stages.title: A conversation away from the camera
stages.text:
Nneka agrees to a private conversation in the quiet service corner.
Nneka: I have work and pay to discuss. I am not your surprise villain.
KC: Understood. No recording.

Her agreement to speak privately is not permission for public use.
stages.summary: Hear Nneka privately without recording; keep public use separate.

choices.label: Put the camera away and listen privately
Record secretly to strengthen the story
choices.hint: Nneka agreed to a private conversation without recording. Respect those terms.

stages.title: Nneka's sequence, in her words
stages.text:
Nneka says she moved the Chief's bag during the blackout to protect the unpaid catering receipts inside it. She meant to hand it to Ngozi. In the confusion she boarded Tunde's bus, then left the bag beneath a seat while taking Bisi to the caterers' room. She returned, found the bus gone and left the message Ngozi received.

This is her account. The 21:14 service request and original footage are separate records to compare.
stages.summary: Retain Nneka's attributed account and distinguish it from independent corroboration.

records.title: Private conversation notes · Nneka
lines: Motive she gives: protect unpaid catering receipts
Bag: left under bus seat while helping Bisi
Afterward: returned; bus gone; left a message

choices.label: Keep the attributed account and compare separate sources
Treat every detail as independently proven already
choices.hint: An account is a source, not proof of every detail. Compare timing, footage, locations and later records.

stages.title: An account beside a timestamp
stages.text:
The original retains a helping action absent from KC's crop. SR-18 logs a 21:14 assistance request for Bisi. They support parts of the account, not every moment or ownership.
Nneka: Ask me what you do not know. Do not make the camera answer for me.
stages.summary: Keep the helping action and 21:14 request as limited corroboration; leave unsupported details open.

choices.label: Keep the helping action and request as limited corroboration
Assign 21:14 to every event in the account
choices.hint: 21:14 belongs to the assistance request, not every bus, bag or folder event.

stages.title: Permission has a scope
stages.text:
Nneka permits private investigation notes. Ask which boundary she chooses for later public work. Any proposed redacted text must still be shown to her during the later witness review.

Neither option permits her name, image, voice or unrelated details. Later withdrawal must be respected. The investigation progresses on both paths.
stages.summary: Save private-only or redacted-text-for-review permission; neither bypasses later exact review or permits identifying media.

choices.label: Keep the account private; public work uses anonymised records
Ask to prepare redacted written text for her later review

stages.title: Read the boundary back

private_only.text:
Nneka: Private notes only. Use the anonymised service records if you make a public case.
KC: Your account stays private. No recording or identifying quote.
private_only.summary: Nneka chose private investigation notes only; public work uses anonymised records.

redacted_review.text:
Nneka: You may prepare redacted text for me to review. No name, picture or voice. Show me the exact version before use.
KC: A later yes covers only that version. You can withdraw.
redacted_review.summary: Nneka permits preparation of redacted text for later exact review, with no identifying media and withdrawal respected.

stages.text: KC reads the boundary back. No witness needs to trade privacy for a clue or reward.
stages.summary: Acknowledge the chosen scope and keep later review/withdrawal available.

choices.label: Respect the saved boundary and later review requirement

stages.title: Leave with notes, not the book

ngozi_record.text: Ngozi's recorded bag custody remains intact. Arrange later folder inspection through that record.
ngozi_record.summary: Ngozi retains the bag under the existing inventory record.

joint_record.text: The joint witnessed bag record remains intact. Check the folder lead with that custodian.
joint_record.summary: Joint bag custody remains intact; the ledger stays at its desk.

stages.text:
The custodian confirms the permitted notes while retaining the ledger.
Ngozi: We came with an invitation and leave with a source line.
KC: Less dramatic. More useful.
stages.summary: Retain source-labelled permitted notes without moving the ledger or changing bag custody.

choices.label: Keep the permitted notes and leave the ledger with its custodian

stages.title: The invitation did some honest work
stages.text:
Aso-Ebi Infiltration complete. Ngozi and KC each gain two mastery once. Nneka's attributed account and the folder lead join the journal; the diary itself is not recovered yet. Service time, opportunity and custody remain saved.

Small Small Receipts follows: compare willing witnesses and records, inspect the folder with its custodian and review exact permission before public use.
stages.summary: Save the account, permission boundary and folder lead; two mastery each without StreetCoins or a prematurely verified diary.

choices.label: Save the visit, account and permission boundary
